description: This file defines the Response class in the Laminas\Diactoros namespace, implementing HTTP response encapsulation with status code management, reason phrases, and immutability features.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an immutable HTTP response with status code, reason phrase, headers, and body.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response.

methods.name: getReasonPhrase
methods.description: Returns the reason phrase associated with the status code.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Returns a new Response instance with the specified status code and reason phrase.

methods.name: setStatusCode
methods.description: Sets a valid status code and reason phrase, validating inputs.
